name: handoff wait prunes an aged receipt and reports it consumed or superseded

source.assertion:
assert_equals "TTL cleanup prunes old receipts, watermarks and orphaned atomic temps" \
  "publish=pruned-replaced aged-wait=1 receipt=absent" \
  "publish=$ttl_publish_cleanup aged-wait=$handoff_rc receipt=$([ -e "$ttl_receipt" ] && printf present || printf absent)"

.local/state/oso-code/.handoffs/{repo}/{.content:
version=1
hook_session=hook-ttl-two
slice=slice-ttl
attempt=2
agent_id=agent-ttl
agent_type=oso-applier
